socket_headgear.note: IDENTITY by construction: every headgear GLB is authored with its vertices already expressed directly in mixamorig:Head bone-local space (measured by baking the welded pith_helmet/rice_hat's true world position through (rig.matrix_world @ Head-pose-bone.matrix).inverted() - see nva_vc/props build script). A BoneAttachment3D on mixamorig:Head with this (identity) local transform, holding the mesh as a direct child, reproduces the fitted position exactly. This differs from assets/us/props/helmets/helmets.json, whose socket carries a non-identity rotation because that helmet was authored in a different reference frame - the two are not interchangeable, each is correct for its own asset family.

socket_pack.note: IDENTITY by the same construction, on mixamorig:Spine1 (upper-mid back). Placement was measured against grunt_torso's own back surface at spine height (see build script) - frame/body sits ~2cm clear of the torso mesh.

socket_chest.note: NEW 2026-08-07, IDENTITY by the same construction as socket_headgear/socket_pack, on mixamorig:Spine2 (upper chest - a pre-existing 'Chest' EMPTY already sits on this exact bone in nva_vc_gear_variants.blend at local Y=-0.130, confirming Spine2 is the right anchor for chest-worn gear). Vertices baked via (rig.matrix_world @ Spine2-pose-bone.matrix).inverted(), verified by round-tripping the FORWARD transform on the existing pack_worn_ruck_light/pith_worn vertices before authoring anything new: pack lands on the back (Y=0.06-0.26 vs a measured back surface of Y=0.10), helmet lands above the head (Z=1.67-1.76 vs a measured head Z=1.54) - same convention, new bone.

pack_ammo.note: TEXTURE ROOT CAUSE FIXED 2026-08-07 (tools/fix_nva_gear_textures.py). The shared `pack_canvas` material - used by this prop plus pack_frame/pack_roll/pack_rpg/pack_ruck_full/pack_ruck_light/pack_satchel/chest_rig_ak/bandolier_ammo (9 props on one material) - had its Base Color Image Texture node wired to `pith_worn_cover.png`, the PITH HELMET's cover sheet, not a canvas image. Not a UV problem - a wrong SOURCE IMAGE on a shared material, which is why it hit 9 unrelated props identically. Repointed to `canvas_od` (the same real canvas sheet `pack_rice_tube`'s approved `webbing_canvas` material already correctly used) - one node edit, fixes all 9 at once. Geometry/tris unchanged.

pack_rpg.note: TEXTURE ROOT CAUSE FIXED 2026-08-07 - see pack_ammo's note. PLACEMENT FIXED 2026-08-07 (tools/fix_pack_rpg.py): the launcher tube (BluedSteelVC.001, 208 tris) and PG-7V warhead (WarheadOD, 264 tris) sat ~2m away from their own canvas sling (pack_canvas, 48 tris) in local space - a disconnected floating gun, not a rendering issue. Rigidly repositioned the tube+warhead cluster onto the sling (no rotation/scale change, shape untouched) and re-verified with a fit-check: 5/298 verts within 5.9cm of the body surface, no gross clipping. The 520-tri count itself is judged justified, not bloat, once the assembly reads as one connected item: an RPG-7 tube + conical warhead is a materially more complex form than a canvas rucksack, and 520 tris for two extra distinct forms is proportionate next to pack_ruck_full's 236 for one canvas sack.
